subject: Request: Preservation Accelerator — Exec authorization for save package
messages:
From: Lisa Chang <lisa@fluxware.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal needs — preservation package request

Evelyn,

Quick note from our renewal committee after the QBR — Fluxware is evaluating a switch unless we can get a firm 12-month price lock plus a stronger SLA and some offset for the recent latency incidents. They specifically want:
- 12-month price lock at current list minus 20%
- One-time service credit to cover migration costs (estimate attached)
- SLA guarantee of 99.95% or a financial makewhole

Attached is our internal impact sheet showing churn risk if we don’t move. Can you confirm whether Redwood can put together an expedited preservation offer? We want to know by end of week.

Thanks,
Lisa Chang\VP Customer Success\Fluxware
Attachment: Fluxware_Renewal_Impact.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chang <lisa@fluxware.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal needs — preservation package request

Lisa — thanks for the note and for the detailed impact sheet. I hear you — losing Fluxware would be a material loss for our marketplace footprint. I’m escalating to our deals desk and execs for an expedited review.

Immediate next steps I’m proposing: I’ll put a recommended save package together (credit + term + SLA options) and loop in Ben and Marcus for deal desk approval. Can you confirm whether Fluxware is willing to extend the renewal decision window by two weeks if we surface a competitive offer? That will help us negotiate responsibly.

I’ll follow up within 24 hours with a concrete ask.

— Evelyn\Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: deals@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T13:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Fluxware — recommended save ask (prep for exec)

Folks — forwarding Fluxware’s ask and Evelyn’s note. Summary and my recommendation below.

Customer ask (from Lisa):
- 12-month price lock at current list - 20%
- One-time service credit (see attached spreadsheet)
- SLA 99.95% with financial remedy

Why we should approve (brief):
- Strategic reference in fintech vertical; visible partner for our marketplace case studies.
- Active usage growth but concentrated spend; churn would reduce ARR by ~10% for our mid-market cohort.
- They are evaluating 2 competitors; timeline is tight (decision in 7 days).

Recommended package (one-time accelerated offer to close renewal):
- Conditional 18-month contract with a stepped pricing: Year 1 at list - 15%, Year 2 at list - 10% (effective blended ~12.5%)
- One-time credit of $50,000 against the Year 1 invoice to offset migration/migration risk
- Temporary SLA uplift to 99.92% for the first 12 months with a 0.5% annual credit applied as a service credit if we miss the target (capped at $75k)
- Commitment: Fluxware signs the 18-month term and a mutual public case study clause (opt-out after 6 months).

Attachments: deal_summary.pdf (1-page deal economics)

Evelyn — can you confirm customer appetite for the 18-month commit? I’ll take this to Marcus and Aditya for exec signoff if yes.

— Ben
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-26T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: EXEC: Fluxware save — approval request and rationale

Marcus / Aditya —

Requesting an expedited exec authorization to approve a preservation concession for Fluxware (DEAL-2026-0781). Fluxware is a high-visibility mid-market account at risk of moving to a direct competitor. The ask is time-sensitive; customer expects a concrete counter by EOW.

What I’m asking you to approve:
- Commercial: blended discounting equivalent to Year 1: list - 15%, Year 2: list - 10% on an 18-month agreement (customer originally wants 12-month lock at -20%)
- Credit: one-time $50,000 credit applied up-front to Year 1 invoice
- SLA: raise to 99.92% for 12 months with a service-credit remedy (0.5% of ARR payable as credit, capped at $75k)
- Non-standard term: 18-month commit rather than standard 12; require mutual PR clause as part of the deal to offset concession

Rationale: balances unit economics vs retention probability; full -20% + 99.95 SLA is too aggressive given precedent. This package buys time, keeps revenue predictable, and gets us a reference.

If approved, I recommend Legal produce a short addendum and Operations run the SLA playbook for monitoring.

— Ben
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-26T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: RE: EXEC: Fluxware save — approval request and rationale

Ben / team — after reviewing the numbers and strategic upside, approve the following WITH CONDITIONS: 

Approved concessions:
- Discount: Year 1 at list - 15% (approved), Year 2 at list - 8% (down from recommended 10%) on an 18-month term
- One-time credit: $50,000 (approved)
- SLA: 99.92% approved for first 12 months; service-credit to apply as a pro rata against invoices with a hard cap at $50,000 (lower than Ben’s cap)

Conditions / required guardrails:
1) Customer must sign an 18-month contract with a 90-day non-cancellable initial period.
2) Fluxware must agree to a joint announcement / case study within 6 months; failure to cooperate voids the credit.
3) Legal to include standard indemnities and remove any precedent-setting language; ops to provide a playbook of monitoring and on-call escalation for the first 90 days.
4) Finance: deal economics to be recorded in the concession register and amortized appropriately.

Aditya — please confirm if you want to escalate any of this to the CRO level; otherwise Ben/Evelyn, execute with Legal.

— Marcus
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chang <lisa@fluxware.com>, Tom Rivera <tom@fluxware.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Preservation Accelerator — Exec authorization for save package

Lisa — thank you for your patience while we reviewed internally. We have an expedited preservation offer we can put in writing today if Fluxware is willing to accept the following package and conditions: 

What we can offer (final):
- Term: 18-month agreement; 90-day non-cancellable initial period
- Commercial: Year 1 at list - 15%; Year 2 at list - 8% (blended pricing applied as an 18-month schedule)
- One-time service credit: $50,000 applied to Year 1 invoice
- SLA: 99.92% for first 12 months; if we miss the SLA a pro rata credit applies against invoices (capped at $50,000)
- Public case study: Fluxware agrees to a joint announcement or case study within 6 months (opt-out removed only if we miss SLA targets twice in the first year)

Conditions: Legal addendum to document limits and removal of precedent language; finance will record concession in the register. Offer expires in 7 business days.

If Fluxware confirms the 18-month term and case study commitment, I’ll send the formal addendum and DocuSign link (we’ve prepped save_offer_v3.docx). Please confirm appetite by EOB Friday and I’ll queue Legal.

Best,
Evelyn Hart\Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: save_offer_v3.docx (offer stub)
